rationale: V4 resolves my sole v3 blocker explicitly: PR17 witness-side WShape is distinguished from producer-SA/WT/WF2 and must be enforced or derived for every adversarial accepted witness; honest producer checking is expressly insufficient. The SubRealizer conclusion is also correctly limited. The frozen Core judgment, separate compiler-route trust inventories, arbitrary-witness constraint soundness, completeness, field representation obligations, signed phase-failure policy and complete effects/history relations make the proposal substantively reviewable without claiming those obligations are already proved. Permissionless public deployment remains separate from internal project review. I endorse this advisory architecture plan, not an implementation or release.
caveats: PR17 remains conditional on its Assumptions module and witness/source premises for an older pinned surface. This review does not reproduce its Agda build or validate concrete chip constraints, backend synthesis, proof-system security or deployed verifier correspondence.

The suggested old-surface instruction mapping is a proposal. Exact emitted instruction/type coverage and semantic-version correspondence remain required; old instruction names alone do not transfer theorems.

The public circuit/ledger acceptance relation is authoritative at execution, but source-level contract, intent and history assurance follows only through the explicitly unestablished correspondence or sound per-artifact translation validation. Runtime acceptance alone must not be marketed as that assurance.

A1 formula discharge is limited to its declared pure Core fragment. Finite testing and validated counterexamples support implementation quality but do not establish universal encoder adequacy or target arbitrary-witness soundness.

The proposed R_I and inductive H are design obligations, not formalized or mechanically checked definitions. Authentication, canonical commitments/openings, phase-indexed cumulative authority, residual liabilities and private disclosure require concrete semantics before assurance claims.
Permissionless compilation and deployment do not promise solver availability, inclusion, liquidity, cross-chain atomicity or freedom from objectively specified fees and native validity requirements.
changes_of_position: Changed CHANGES_REQUESTED on v3 to ENDORSE on v4 because the PR17-WITNESS-PREMISE blocker is incorporated explicitly, including adversarial-witness quantification and the limitation of honest producer checks. No claim of technical theorem-premise closure is inferred from that documentation correction.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: An implementation or revised plan accepting witnesses without deriving/enforcing WShape or an equivalent adequate relation would reopen the soundness objection.

Concrete mismatch between frozen Core rejection/range/work semantics and emitted constraints, omitted signed failure outcomes or fees, unbound effects or mutable prover-selected property relations would require changes.
Administrative permission or project-review receipts required of independent developers for public deployment would contradict the endorsed product contract.

A reproduced proof and concrete version-bound correspondence could strengthen the assurance assessment; absence of these does not block the current plan because it explicitly records them as unestablished work.
